brief: Reference-led organic Ancient Treant with dense foliage on the body, clear readable silhouette and controlled surface detail. Artwork on the right and information space on the left.
referenceRoles: User reference 1: ancient weight, shoulder gesture and fog
User reference 4: organic anatomy, painterly forest atmosphere
User reference 6: moss integration and expressive face
Initial generated Treant: dense foliage coverage only
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a NEW Ancient Treant world-boss painting. Wide 5:2 landscape, ideally 2400 x 960, one finished painting without text or UI. The Treant dominates the right two-thirds; dark quiet woodland on the left allows future card copy.

Reference roles: Input images 1 and 2 (the two atmospheric forest paintings) are the primary guides for painterly quality, ancient weight, organic anatomy, and misty light. Image 3 guides the living moss integrated into bark and expressive threatening face. Image 4 guides the twisting, asymmetric creature gesture. Image 5 is an earlier Treant design: use ONLY its generous dense green foliage growing over the body. The new painting must be organic and richly alive, with foliage restored.

Creature design: An enormous ancient oak guardian, a walking fragment of primeval woodland. A weathered trunk twists upward into a long expressive wooden face. His shoulder on the viewer's right rises higher, carrying a small thriving thicket. Gnarled arms grow naturally from the trunk, one broad root hand reaching forward and the other lower in shadow. Show the curved weight of an actual old tree rather than a muscular human torso. A few old broken boughs emerge from a leafy crown around the head. Low brow, deep eye sockets, two subtle olive-gold eyes, a stern ancient personality.

DENSE FOLIAGE IS ESSENTIAL: thick cushions of moss, overlapping ivy leaves, fern fronds and small woodland growth cover the shoulders, upper chest, back and parts of the forearms. Arrange the growth in lush connected clusters that follow the body, with a few elegant hanging vines. Dense olive and deep green foliage creates a soft living mantle; readable bark remains between the clusters. Design larger leaf groups first and place selective leaf shapes within them. The whole body should feel inhabited by a forest.

Painting approach: traditional-feeling fantasy concept illustration, confident brushwork, natural organic forms, a rich yet controlled level of detail. Broad continuous bark ridges, smooth transitions of shadow, grouped foliage with clear lighting. The outer silhouette remains coherent and easy to read, with deliberate branches and foliage masses. Concentrate definition in the face and nearer hand; soften texture into the torso shadows. Avoid evenly distributed speckled highlights, mottled noise, serrated little splinters and scratch marks. Keep substantial calm surfaces between textured areas. Neither blocky simplified shapes nor uniformly hyperdetailed surfaces.

Atmosphere and composition: muted forest greens, warm earthy wood and cool slate mist. Diffuse light illuminates the foliage and upper bark, with a quiet lighter fog behind the head and shoulders. Head near 74% across, 28% down, visible hands and shoulders comfortably within the canvas. Dark forest fades naturally across the left. Low viewpoint, imposing scale, thoughtful asymmetry, credible ancient-tree structure.

No chest rune, jewel, glowing torso, neon greens, sparkles, airborne leaf confetti, tiny repeated textures, hard geometric armour, exaggerated bodybuilder anatomy, cartoon styling, humans, text, signatures, watermark, card frame or border.
